name: @chaoticgoodcomputing/obsidian-markdown
description: Obsidian Markdown for Sätteri: the syntax as mdast plugins, and a vault's metadata cache (links, embeds, tags, headings, blocks, backlinks) modelled on Obsidian's own. No Astro in it.
//exports: Source only: no build and no dist. Astro's Vite compiles it, and Node strips its types for the tests.
//scripts: Node strips the types (unflagged only from Node 22.18; the repo's .nvmrc is 22.16), so sources import each other with their .ts extension.
